hypothesis: Four independent research agents will return bounded evidence for the board-support contract decision.
command: multi_agent_v1 spawn four read-only research tasks; wait_agent
result: All four agents failed before returning artifacts with upstream 503 Service Unavailable responses; no repository files were modified.
revert_evidence: No repository edits from the failed agents; their completed threads were closed.
lesson: Subagent availability is an evidence dependency; retry one scoped synthesis task, then fall back to direct canonical-source research if the service remains unavailable.

hypothesis: Failing closed on cross-profile lookup collisions and malformed evidence values will make future board additions safer for AI retrieval.
command: python3 scripts/validate_board_references.py; python3 scripts/run_arduino_evals.py --output evals/eval-results.json; python3 -m py_compile scripts/*.py; git diff --check

lesson: The compact index must enforce retrieval uniqueness and evidence shape, not only field presence.

hypothesis: Fresh-context acceptance and quality reviewers will independently validate trigger ownership and progressive disclosure.
command: multi_agent_v1 spawn verifier and skill_reviewer; bounded wait; close timed-out agents
result: Both reviewers timed out without a verdict artifact after the upstream research service had already returned repeated 503 responses.

hypothesis: A source-backed identity contract and deterministic resolver will prevent variant-sensitive board guidance from being emitted when the requested board identity is incomplete.

result: Resolver-backed exact lookup, ambiguity, unsupported-board, profile-gap, pin-handoff, toolchain, composed-route, and held-out trigger-corpus shape checks pass; 29 skills, 9 profiles, 8/8 shared themes, 18/18 forward cases, protected hashes, syntax, diff, and plugin validation pass.
